product.name: Open Video Guide
product.mission: Turn a tutorial video into an evidence-grounded illustrated guide.

current_milestone.name: User-tested local review workflow
current_milestone.objective: Measure the complete review workflow and improve silent-video quality.

verified_capabilities.name: Local speech and vision model profile

task_queue.title: Run a guided user test with a silent software tutorial.
acceptance: The user completes upload, review, save, and export.
The test records completion time and correction problems.
The repository contains a dated evidence record.

task_queue.title: Replace fixed-only frame selection with visual change signals.
acceptance: Candidate selection uses scene, motion, or interface-change evidence.
A benchmark compares the change with the fixed-window baseline.

task_queue.title: Add resumable web jobs.
acceptance: An interrupted job continues without duplicate artifacts.
The job record keeps each completed stage.

task_queue.title: Complete the first repository threat model.
acceptance: The model covers media, browser, model, and client boundaries.
Each high risk has a control or an accepted owner.
The risk register matches the threat model.

task_queue.title: Test installation on a clean supported computer.
acceptance: A new user follows only the installation guide.
The package creates and exports one guide.
The test records download, disk, memory, and time data.

known_limits: Fixed windows can combine actions or miss short actions.
Silent-video quality does not meet the release gate.
A running web job does not resume after interruption.
The local editor does not delete stored jobs.
Every generated step needs user review.
non_negotiable_rules: Keep the product local-first and open source.
Do not require a paid Artificial intelligence service.
Keep evidence and timestamps with each generated step.
Keep the core engine independent from client adapters.
Do not commit private media, model weights, logs, or generated guides.
Do not claim a capability without test evidence.
handoff_rules: The latest user request has priority over the task queue.
Inspect the current Git state before you make a plan.
Preserve user changes and unrelated work.
Update this file only when semantic project state changes.
Run the handoff command before you transfer work.
